name: IccmSickChild
title: iCCM sick child 2–59 months
description: Community case management of a sick child: refer on any general danger sign or when younger than 2 months, otherwise treat malaria (fever with a positive RDT) and fast-breathing pneumonia at home and follow up on day 3.

action.title: Refer urgently to the health facility

expression.expression: ((%assessment.entry.resource.item.where(linkId in ('unable-to-drink' | 'vomits-everything' | 'convulsions' | 'lethargic' | 'chest-indrawing')).answer.value contains true) or (%assessment.entry.resource.item.where(linkId = 'age-months').where(answer.value.first() < 2).exists())).not() and (%assessment.entry.resource.item.where(linkId = 'fever').answer.value contains true) and (%assessment.entry.resource.item.where(linkId = 'rdt-result').answer.value.code contains 'positive')

((%assessment.entry.resource.item.where(linkId in ('unable-to-drink' | 'vomits-everything' | 'convulsions' | 'lethargic' | 'chest-indrawing')).answer.value contains true) or (%assessment.entry.resource.item.where(linkId = 'age-months').where(answer.value.first() < 2).exists())).not() and ((%assessment.entry.resource.item.where(linkId = 'cough').answer.value contains true) and ((%assessment.entry.resource.item.where(linkId = 'age-months').answer.value.first() < 12 and %assessment.entry.resource.item.where(linkId = 'respiratory-rate').answer.value.first() >= 50) or (%assessment.entry.resource.item.where(linkId = 'age-months').answer.value.first() >= 12 and %assessment.entry.resource.item.where(linkId = 'respiratory-rate').answer.value.first() >= 40)))
